beats.caption: Dromore, in Irish An Droim Mór. Here is the story of Dromore and its 32 families, from 1901 to 1926.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 147, 134 and 113 people in Dromore, in 30, 30 and 25 households. Heads of household included Flagherty, Burns and Martin.
Here are the families of Dromore, from 1901 to 1926. First, the Porter and Wilson families.
